ns2:section.sectionText: Online and Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. This online course will use Compass. Overview of major works, figures, and trends responsible for shaping dance as an evolving contemporary art form. For non-dance majors. Enrollment in this course section is restricted to non-residential, nondegree students only. Students in this section will be enrolled in the same Compass course section with students in the DANC 100 OL2 section.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC or NDEG:Undergrad Nondeg-CE-UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $362.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $325.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
